lines.zh: 黑森林里，我的羽毛最暗
lines.en: In the dark forest, my feathers are the darkest.

lines.zh: 半夜走路，谁也看不见我
lines.en: Walking at midnight, no one sees me.
I step on leaves without a sound.
Night dyed these feathers.
Cluck, I head for the shadows.
Two claws, quick steps.
The dark forest is too dense.
I walk close to the roots.
Bugs taste best at night.

lines.zh: 翅膀扑两下，算是走快了
lines.en: A couple of flaps count as running.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有细碎声
lines.en: Little rustles follow my steps.
Gaps between mushrooms fit me.
I only wander once it's dark.
Not a glint on my feathers.

lines.zh: 一只鸡，也能走得很谨慎
lines.en: Even a chicken can walk warily.
That shifting tree shadow is me.
Standing still, I'm a black stone.

lines.zh: 我歪头，听林子里的动静
lines.en: I tilt my head, listening to the woods.
It's dark, and I'm not sleepy.
The dark forest is quiet at night.
I ruffle my feathers loose a few.
There's a bug under the bark.
I'm in the dark; no one finds me.
Chickens fear the dark; I don't.
Standing on one leg saves effort.
An occasional cluck to keep my nerve.
Night hides my color.
I've been here a long while.

lines.zh: 林子深处有声音，不是我
lines.en: Something deeper in the woods, not me.
My eyes shine in the dark.
Other chickens sleep at this hour.
Moonlight doesn't reach this forest.
Feathers fluffed for warmth.
A bit more waiting, then I forage.
Your torch is far too bright.
You see me? That's a surprise.
Don't shine that at me; it stings.
Someone awake at midnight is strange.
I tilt my head at you, no ill will.
You've stepped onto my ground.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛在黑里看不出来吧
lines.en: Can you even see my feathers in this dark?
You smell of chicken feed.
One look, then leave; don't follow.

lines.zh: 我不是普通鸡，你记住了
lines.en: I'm no ordinary chicken; remember that.
Your steps are too heavy; you startled me.
The eyes in the dark are mine.
A handful of my feathers fell.
Cluck! That hurts.
I beat my wings and hop clear.
Even this small frame gets hit.
My wing's bent.

lines.zh: 黑里挨打，跑都不知道往哪
lines.en: Hit in the dark, and nowhere to run.
I shudder.
A chicken shouldn't hurt this much.
My squawk sounds awful.
I'll remember that a long while.
Seeds? Not in the dark forest.
What's that in your palm?

lines.zh: 我跟着走，只要撒得够多
lines.en: I'll follow if you scatter enough.
Don't clench it; open your hand.
Cluck, that smells good.

lines.zh: 夜里的食最难找，你来得巧
lines.en: Food's scarce at night; good timing.
One peck and I'm off.
Whenever you shake your hand, I follow.
Better than bugs.
Scatter it; I'll peck it myself.
I'll trust you once.

lines.zh: 再往前一点，那里有种子
lines.en: A bit further; there are seeds there.
My stomach is bigger than my courage.
Walk slower; my legs are short.
This smell makes me forget the dark.
One last grain; don't cheat me.
You stepped on my tail feathers.
One bump and a few feathers fell.
Not your feet; I'm small.
Let me through.
Two flaps and I'm steady.
You're far heavier than me.
In the dark, neither of us saw.

lines.zh: 我咕咕叫了两声，是抱怨
lines.en: Two clucks of complaint.
I hop away when touched.
My wing brushed you; sorry.
Even a midnight chicken wants company.
These dark feathers suit you.
The forest corners are quiet.
Let's hunt bugs together.
My clucking is an invitation.
Don't step on my eggs; agreed?

lines.zh: 两只鸡走夜路，没那么怕
lines.en: Two chickens at night fear less.
Feather against feather means yes.
The woods are big enough for us.
Follow me; don't get lost.
A seed on the ground.
Pecked up and swallowed.
A night bug, perfect.
I hold it, afraid it'll be taken.
Two pecks, good aim.
A small thing, tucked in feathers.
Don't grab it; I saw it first.
Let me peck it open.
That glint on the ground is a bug.
Eat, then find the next.
You've annoyed me; take a peck.
My wings are spread.
Even a small chicken charges.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，我比你先动手
lines.en: In the dark forest, I strike first.
Don't underestimate this beak.
I lunge fast.
Step back and I'll let it go.
Cluck cluck, one warning.
I'm braver at night.
This one goes for your ankle.

lines.zh: 我踩着你影子的边绕圈。
lines.en: I circle along the edge of your shadow.
In the dark I watch closely.
Move, and I hop.
I'm not truly fierce, but I hold grudges.
My feathers are up.
I've marked your feet.
Come closer and I charge.

lines.zh: 黑森林这块地，我说了算。
lines.en: This patch of dark forest answers to me.
Waiting for you to come close.
One opening and I peck.
One peck, dead on.
Wings flapping in your face.
A quick rake of my claws.
I hop up and butt you.
Small beak, real pain.

lines.zh: 黑里挨一下，你都不知道哪来的
lines.en: In the dark, you won't know what hit you.
I flap and ram you.
And another.
You step on me, I peck you.
Hit, then run.
Dark feathers shake out.
The dark forest has one more chicken.
I step out of the shadows.
Cluck, I'm here.
Dark enough here; perfect.

lines.zh: 夜里的林子，热闹了一点
lines.en: The night woods got a bit livelier.
I shake my wings and steady myself.
I know the dark forest's smell.
The feather on the ground is mine.
I appear quietly.
Fire makes my feathers shrink.
I fell and my wings didn't catch me.
I can't swim; I only thrash.
The blast flipped me over.
Something lodged in my feathers.
This pain isn't like a peck.
No food in the dark forest; I'm starving.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我一身羽毛都竖了
lines.en: Lightning struck; every feather stood up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我扑腾也没用
lines.en: Nothing below; flapping won't help.
